title: penstemon fruticosus
intro: Penstemon fruticosus, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Penstemon, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the western United States and Canada, belonging to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its multiple health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Penstemon fruticosus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving coughs, colds, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
